What this coating reference models

Only prepared upper faces react; side/back access excluded. Two finite iron zones share mixed finite oxygen and water. Relative access and bare coefficient are chosen, not measured permeability or corrosion kinetics. Uniform product and film layers are volume references; film follows the covered top without a mechanical lifting, cracking or adhesion calculation. No galvanic protection, pitting, lateral under-film transport, sorption, dissolved oxygen/vapour storage, finite wetting or heat solver. All product retained attached. Generic barriers do not rank real paints or predict lifetime. Cell view uses a zero-volume schematic wick.
